name: Camarat
source_1_phrase: 'The New Noord Cuisine' ... klassieke stijlen naar het nu, met invloeden uit Frankrijk en Scandinavië
source_2_phrase: French classics with international influences, including from Scandinavian soil
notes: ADDRESS MISMATCH: brief gives Johan van Hasseltweg 51; AmsterdamNow and an openingstijden.nl listing give Gedempt Hamerkanaal 4 (1021 KL). Own site names no street (only Amsterdam-Noord, phone +31 20 895 0610). Same Amsterdam-Noord venue (site/name/owners match) but street must be verified before import. Both sources frame French/Scandinavian as influences on a charcoal-grill, local/seasonal kitchen; Seasonal Cuisine is a defensible alternative (own site: 'lokale en seizoensgebonden producten').

name: Dame aan de Kade
source_1_phrase: influences from Mediterranean and European cuisine
source_2_phrase: Mediterranean-European menu full of comfort food
notes: Own site (dameaandekade.nl, Ruysdaelkade 169-H confirmed) does not describe the cuisine at all: only 'Bar & restaurant in De Pijp', 'goed eten en drinken'; menu is behind an image/PDF link not read. Both sources are independent of the venue and agree, but neither is the restaurant's own words. Small sharing plates per Bart's Boekje. AmsterdamNow and Bart's Boekje name different owners.

name: Mont Blanc
source_1_phrase: fine dining in de Pijp / Proef het beste uit de Savoie
source_2_phrase: Savoyard, Modern Cuisine ... Expect Alpine cuisine with natural undertones
notes: Address Govert Flinckstraat 308 matches on both. Savoie/Savoyard is not on the fixed list; Alpine is the closest plain label. Michelin's second label is Modern Cuisine (not added: own site does not use it).

name: Petit Péché
source_1_phrase: uitgesproken gerechten met krachtige smaken, seizoensproducten ... menu opgebouwd rond vlees en vis
source_2_phrase: sophisticated cuisine ... local produce ... surprising, sometimes forgotten ingredients
notes: Address Nicolaas Beetsstraat 51h matches. No source names a cuisine type; 'Seasonal' rests on the own site only (AmsterdamNow says local produce, changing menu). Conflict: Bart's Boekje (Feb 2024, chef Karin Gaasterland) said menu mostly meat- and fish-free; own site now says menu built on meat and fish under chef Wes ten Kleij (chef change, not independently confirmed). Moves to Outpost Zandvoort May-Sep.

name: Tacite
source_1_phrase: seizoensmenu met Franse basis en Aziatische en mediterrane invloeden
source_2_phrase: French base ... seasonal produce and fish from the North Sea
notes: Address Cornelis Krusemanstraat 15 matches on both. Asian/Mediterranean influences mentioned by the own site only, not used.

name: Troef
source_1_phrase: een bistro met Franse invloeden, een open keuken en unieke wijnruimte
source_2_phrase: Modern French ... the occasionally creative take on French classics
notes: Address Schollenbrugstraat 8, 1091 EX matches on both. Own-site phrase is from the homepage meta description (visible page has no cuisine text; menu is images only). Michelin labels it Modern French; plain French chosen since the venue says only 'Franse invloeden'.
